mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25pp over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 in any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 in 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 1.0% m/m for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 in 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO above 110.0), the economy is in an expansion phase where corporate profits are rising, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 110.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 in 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% yoy, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 in 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% m/m for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 in 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a contraction in the real economy that reduces corporate profitability and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline by at least 0.5% q/q for 2 consecutive quarters, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong housing market activity (HOUST above 1300.0), the housing sector's contribution to GDP growth and consumer confidence supports positive equity returns, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1300.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in 3-year rolling windows.
